title: Selection, re-evaluation and fail-closed semantics
summary: A request receives authoritative candidate identifiers; deterministic priority and scoped narrative selection precede an independent fresh authority check. The result carries explanation, proof-ref and exact revisions.
invariants: Each decideLive request asks current intention source for candidates again.
Equal-priority candidate collisions block; unknown intentions cannot become eligible.
No headline, body, CTA or claim set is returned in a blocked decision.
Local mock authority in tests is never production authorisation.

provenance.claim: User-supplied dev1 base, upgraded to source candidate dev2; no dev2 runtime acceptance claimed
